items.title: How Q2 Earnings, Tariff Refund and CEO Shift At Home Depot (HD) Has Changed Its Investment Story
items.summary: In August 2026, Home Depot reported second-quarter sales of US$47,861 million and net income of US$4,766 million, reaffirmed its fiscal 2026 guidance, declared a US$2.33 quarterly dividend payable on September 17, 2026, and temporarily reassigned CEO duties during Edward Decker’s medical leave.
